subcategory_text: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes
informative_references: CRI Profile v2.0: GV.RM-03, GV.RM-03.01, GV.RM-03.02, GV.RM-03.03, GV.RM-03.04
implementation_examples: Aggregate and manage cybersecurity risks alongside other enterprise risks (e.g., compliance, financial, operational, regulatory, reputational, safety)
Include cybersecurity risk managers in enterprise risk management planning
Establish criteria for escalating cybersecurity risks within enterprise risk management
assessment_objectives: Determine whether cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that aggregate and manage cybersecurity risks alongside other enterprise risks (e.g., compliance, financial, operational, regulatory, reputational, safety).
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that include cybersecurity risk managers in enterprise risk management planning.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
